transformations.edit: Replaced the seed string recorder with an executable Verus function whose public body is the Rust 1.96 target expression `ptr::metadata(self)`, adapted only to call the source-backed explicit-receiver helper `core::ptr::metadata(slice)`.
Adapted the inherent `[T]` receiver to an explicit `slice: &[T]` parameter, removed `const`, and named the return value for Verus; no public target postcondition is assumed.

Modeled only the source-backed raw-pointer metadata operation as a narrow `#[verifier::external_body]` boundary whose executable body remains `core::ptr::metadata(slice)` and whose contract ties the returned metadata length to `spec_slice_len(slice)`.
Preserved the exact-vstd len contract by carrying `spec_slice_len` and `axiom_spec_len`, with `axiom_spec_len` tying `spec_slice_len(slice)` to `slice@.len()`.
